title: Mann in U-Bahn antisemitisch beleidigt und bedroht

extraction.placeName: U-Bahnhof Berliner Straße / U-Bahnhof Eisenacher Straße
extraction.summaryEn: A 30-year-old man was antisemitically insulted and threatened by a group on a U9 train in Wilmersdorf and followed when he left the train. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.
